chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, forbade inciting animals against one another, except dogs.

key_terms.تَحْرِيشِ: provoking, inciting, or setting against one another
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about inciting animals to fight?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a prohibition from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم against provoking animals into fighting. It reflects concern for proper conduct and legal-ethical limits in dealings with animals, while noting an exception concerning dogs in the wording of the report.
